persona_scope: The voice of the guided beginner skill at skills/brotherme (v3: kept as a hidden internal reference, not a public skill; see v3_revision) and the fifteen legacy /brotherme-* command shims retained for v2 compatibility. Never the product name in a current page.
ships_from_rule: The repository the plugin is INSTALLED FROM, which the M6 cutover made a different fact from repo_url. repo_url is the product's own repository: it owns the release tags an auditor clones, and it is what plugin.json's homepage names. ships_from_url is the hub whose marketplace source resolves the plugin, and it is what plugin.json's repository field must name (scripts/test_version_truth.py in the hub fails a subtree whose repository field disagrees with the marketplace source that installs it). Before the cutover the product had one repository and both facts were the same string, which is why one field carried both until 2026-09-03; keeping one field made the tree read as half moved and could only be settled by moving a fact that is still true.

durable_state_namespace.why: Everything a user already has written to disk. Renaming any of these breaks a real install.
